# opnsense_firewall_group (Resource)

Firewall groups allow multiple interfaces to be grouped together and referenced as a single firewall interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Define a category for use in filter examples
resource "opnsense_firewall_group" "example" {
  
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Set of String) Interfaces that belong to this firewall group.
- `name` (String) The name of the firewall group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for this firewall group.
- `no_group` (String) Whether the group should not be included in automatically generated interface groups. Defaults to `"0"`.
- `sequence` (Number) The sequence number used to order firewall groups. Must be between `0` and `9999`. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_firewall_group using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_firewall_group.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_firewall_group using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_firewall_group.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
